work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act answers Francis I on a granddaughter's birth and Ferdinand's marriage and condoles on Cardinal Archduke Rudolf's death. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF14306; own dating clause LF14383–14386 reads: Datum Romae sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima quarta decembris millesimo octingen- tesimo trigesimo primo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo. *. Own provenance note LF14406 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
